data.revised_prompt: Stylized concept revision of a single original floating AI mascot named Mofei, centered on a pale blue-white studio background with generous padding. Preserve this exact core design: a compact near-round 1.25:1 oval thin crystal-glass pod body, clear cool-white and icy-blue liquid-glass shell, luminous deep-ocean-blue inner space, a dominant recessed rounded-square blue face visor on the front occupying about 56% of body width and 48% of body height, no mouth, two large widely-spaced vertical white-blue luminous eyes, and one thin blue-white orbital ribbon diagonally sweeping around the lower body. New critical feature: on both sides place two large elegant translucent glass C-shaped screenshot-recognition frame brackets, each bracket about 54% of the pod height, clearly larger than normal side details, with a wide open inward-facing gap toward the face visor so they read as camera focus / screenshot crop frames rather than headphones. Construct each C frame from separated upper and lower rounded-corner strokes, with subtle scan-blue inner edge light; keep brackets close to but floating outside the shell. No gears, no earcups, no arms, no legs, no base. Delicate clear blown-glass material, thin refraction, soft inner glow, Apple-like liquid glass aesthetic, not plastic, vinyl, or chrome. One centered character only, no text, labels, logos, watermark, UI panels, poster layout, humans, or scenery.
